application_review: Actual complex finite-set means commute in two variables, commute with subtraction of a constant on nonempty sets, and have a genuine difference norm bound. A mean of modulus at least 3*delta*B/4 with pointwise modulus at most B has at least delta/4 of its actual summands of modulus at least delta*B/2.

For the actual integer cube [0,N)^kappa, any actual natural direction vector bounded by L, and actual short line length M>0, iterated original cube/line averaging changes the original complex cube mean by at most 2*B*card(kappa)*L*M/N. The genuine integer-box translation theorem controls every actual line shift before averaging.

With actual line length floor(N/L^2), L>0, N>=L^2 and 8*card(kappa)<=delta*L, an actual original cube mean of modulus at least delta*B yields at least delta/4 of actual cube origins whose actual short-line means have modulus at least delta*B/2. This proves the initial actual bounded-observable short-line averaging/density step in the equal-side correction.

Complex-valued averages are handled by their modulus and triangle inequalities. No invalid ordering or common phase of complex numbers is assumed. The dense-origin proof bounds the sum of actual norms by the low threshold times the entire original cube size plus B times the actual large-value set size; original mean normalization and B>0 are used before cancellation.

The actual line shift is coordinatewise x_j+q_j*n with natural q_j<=L and n<M. Each actual translation error uses the already proved true uniform integer-box mass comparison. The absolute real shift is bounded by L*M. Commutation of actual finite averages then transports these shift estimates to original cube/line averages. A global pointwise bound on f is explicit, including shifted points outside the cube, as supplied by an original bounded nilmanifold observable.

Actual natural floor division obeys (N/L^2)*L^2<=N, and positivity of the actual short line length follows from N>=L^2 and L>0. These imply L*floor(N/L^2)/N<=1/L. The explicit condition 8*card(kappa)<=delta*L gives error<=delta*B/4. Original obstruction>=delta*B therefore retains mean modulus>=3*delta*B/4, to which the genuine dense-value theorem applies.

This formalizes only the initial averaging/density step, not the external one-parameter theorem or the subsequent inverse polynomial estimates. The primary correction source is https://arxiv.org/pdf/1311.6170v3, Section 3 Lemma 3.1. The OpenAI prescribed equal-cube route is retained; the main quantitative analytic input and complete original StrongConjecture remain open.

StrongConjecture remains unproved; no unavoidable obstruction is established. The full original filtered smooth lattice basis and its identical-column rational basis, actual bracket constants and all natural lower-central suffixes are retained. Its adaptation to the paper prescribed stretched filtration is now proved by the actual index ((i ceilingDiv D)-1). This does not assert adaptation to an arbitrary supplied filtration or literal equality with earlier separately chosen bases. Actual linear Log prefix criteria for every layer and actual ordered horizontal head coordinates are proved. Full nonlinear ordered-coordinate prefix criteria for every deeper group layer are not yet claimed. The paper horizontal torus is now realized by a continuous surjective original head projection with actual commutator kernel and exact Gamma integer lattice image. Every actual continuous Gamma-integral nonzero group character is uniquely an actual real-linear Log character. Its filtered horizontal Euclidean coefficient norm, actual integral grid and bounded rational normalization/actual Gamma exponential periods are proved; any additional uniform rational-height bounds remain to be derived as needed. The corrected equal-side quantitative Leibman actual character existence and uniform modular binomial coefficient bounds remain open. Finite character grids and conditional real-box coefficient transfer do not prove that analytic existence/bound input. Connect actual finite obstruction existence/bounds to normalized rough-progression descent and finish density extraction, dimension induction, length restriction, cofinal scales, zero-dimensional base and full uniform rough-step comparison. Conditional face laws, face invariance, buffered short-bin geometry, prior-event positivity, extra-conditioning posterior control, quantitative smooth-observable bounds and positive-probability Alignment remain open. HasNativePeriodicIntervalInverse and HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remain explicit unproved existence inputs. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic finite sums/products extraction remains open. Author verification only: no independent kernel replay, external review, public repository, PR or award application is claimed. The complete original prize theorem remains the goal and submission target. The initial actual equal-cube short-line mean approximation and delta/4 dense-origin step are now proved with explicit floor length and direction/error conditions. This is not a proof of quantitative Leibman: actual one-parameter character existence/uniform smoothness bounds, multivariate small-value coefficient estimates, common-character/direction extraction and bounded rational coefficient reconstruction still require proofs. The correction must keep its equal-side scope; no unsupported arbitrary rectangular quantitative theorem is introduced.
